chunks: Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, and Ali ibn Muhammad, from Salih ibn Abi Hammad, both together from Ibn Abi Umeyr and Safwan, from Ibrahim al-Karkhi, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), who said:

You should say upon the Aqeeqa, when you perform it: 'In the Name of Allah and by Allah. O Allah, an Aqeeqa for so-and-so, its flesh for his flesh, its blood for his blood, and its bones for his bones. O Allah, make it a shield for the Progeny of Muhammad (peace be upon him and his family).'

key_terms.آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ: The Progeny of Muhammad: The family of the Prophet, often referring to the Imams in Shia tradition.
key_terms.عَقِيقَةٌ: Aqeeqa: The ritual sacrifice of an animal performed on behalf of a newborn child.
key_terms.وِقَاءً: Shield/Protection: A ransom or covering that protects the subject from harm.

ai.seo_question: What is the correct supplication to recite during the Aqeeqa sacrifice?
ai.summary: This narration from al-Kafi outlines the specific supplication for Aqeeqa, highlighting the Shia emphasis on the animal serving as a vicarious ransom (fidya) for the newborn. The invocation explicitly links the child's protection to the Ahl al-Bayt, reflecting the theological concept of their intercessory role and spiritual shield in safeguarding the faithful from calamity.

en.hubeali:
Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, and Ali Bin Muhammad, from Salih Bin Abu Hammad, both together from Ibn Abu Umeyr, and Safwan, from Ibrahim Al Karkhy, 
Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> has said:

‘You should be saying upon the Aqeeqa, when you perform it, ‘In the Name of Allahazwj, and by Allahazwj. O Allahazwj! I am performing Aqeeqa for so and so, its flesh by his flesh, and its blood by his blood, and its bones by his bones. O Allahazwj! Make it a shield for the Progenyasws of Muhammadsaww’.
en.sarwar: 1. Ali ibn Ibrahim has narrated from his father and Afi ibn Muhammad from Salih ibn abu Hammad all from ibn abu ‘Umayr and Safwan from Ibrahim al-Karkhiy who has said the following: “Abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said, ‘

When you offer ‘Aqiqah say, ‘In the name of Allah and with Allah; it is an ‘Aqiqah for so and so. Its flesh is for his flesh, its blood for his blood and its bones for his bones. O Lord, make it a protection for Muhammad and family of Muhammad, O Allah, grant compensation to Muhammad and his family worthy of their services to Your cause.’”
